_comment: Overrides for pinch_sim.app --real-arm (real_arm.py): plan for the real arm of manipulator_control_ws (next to mujoco_sim). Merged into demo.json section by section, so they are part of config_sha. The arm's joint limits and HOME are read from its config/robot.yaml at start (never copied here). The real HOME is -1 x the demo ready pose: the real arm works on model -Y, so targets, the desk and the cameras are mirrored.

target._theta_note: 2026-10-26: under the real limits (J1 +-45, margin 0.05 rad) targets r 0.25-0.30 on -Y are reachable for theta -20..+60 deg; J1 = 0 points at theta ~ +20 (the 9 cm shoulder offset). The bands are +-15..30 deg around it; to be fixed with scripts/workspace_scan.py --real-arm.

limits._note: 0.95: the arm streams the trajectory with PV = speed + a small correction, capped at PV 262 = 22.5 deg/s; planning at 21.4 deg/s leaves that headroom. qdd 1.2 rad/s^2 = 68.8 deg/s^2 <= the arm's acceptance 70 (its stream PA is 100.6 deg/s^2).
